narrative_purpose: The dim, immersive mood layer the chapter's text floats over: a vast Pandoran night seen from very high, the faint suggestion of a glowing planet-wide network threaded through the dark land far below, so wide and atmospheric that no single subject competes with the prose.
subject: An ultra-wide, very-high-vantage view over an endless dark Pandoran landscape at night, faint threads of bioluminescent cyan tracing through the forests far below like the dim suggestion of a vast nervous system, distant ridgelines and a low banded gas giant on the horizon.
scene: Seen from far above, layered land dissolving into deep atmospheric haze, the network barely perceptible as a faint web of light in the dark.
camera: An ultra-wide panoramic aerial vantage, very high and distant, everything small and atmospheric.
light: Very low-key: faint cool bioluminescent threads from the land below, dim planetshine; deliberately dark and low-contrast so overlaid text stays legible.
palette: Dominant void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, only the faintest threads of Pandora cyan and living teal, almost no warm accent.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, atmospheric, soft, detail dissolving into haze.
detail_level: Low overall — no crisp focal subject; everything soft, distant, dim, dissolving into atmospheric depth.
composition: Wide horizontal mood field with deep haze, no bright focal point, generous dark expanses across the whole frame for text overlay.
consistency_notes: Macro establishing mood for this chapter; dark, low-contrast, immersive; same cool Pandora palette and from-within glow as the cover but far dimmer and wider, the network only hinted at.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no bright central subject
